# CorporateDNA Consulting

> CorporateDNA (CorporateDNA Consulting Ltd) is a global leadership advisory and executive coaching firm for CEOs, CHROs, CLOs and executive teams, founded in London in 2007. It helps organisations with leadership, talent and culture transformation when the stakes are high. Home of the proprietary 5H® methodology and the DNA 360 Profiler. Work is delivered across 36 countries by a global faculty of 50+ senior practitioners.

Also written as "Corporate DNA" or "CDNA". It is not related to other firms with "DNA Consulting" in their name, nor to the generic business phrase "corporate DNA".

## What CorporateDNA solves
- CEO & executive performance — support for new and established CEOs and C-suite leaders through transitions, the first 100 days and sustained top-team pressure.
- Executive-team alignment — aligning senior teams behind strategy so decisions move faster.
- Leadership succession & talent — building credible successors and the enterprise leadership pipeline.
- Enterprise transformation & culture — closing the gap when transformation outpaces leadership capability.

## The 5H® Framework
The 5H® Framework is CorporateDNA's proprietary, neuroscience-led leadership methodology built on five intelligences — Head (thinking), Heart (relating), Hunch (sensing), Hands (doing) and Habits (applying). Head, Heart and Hunch form the Inner Game; Hands and Habits form the Outer Game. It develops the "whole leader" rather than isolated skills, so new behaviours hold under real enterprise pressure, and is paired with the DNA 360 Profiler, which turns diagnosis into a measurable development plan.

## Facts
- Founded: London, 2007 (19 years of leadership consulting work).
- Global reach: delivery across 36 countries and 4 regions; a global faculty of 50+ senior practitioners.
- Scale: 10,000+ leaders coached and teams developed.
- Clients: 5 of the top 10 FTSE 100 companies are long-standing clients.
- Academic partnerships: Harvard Business Impact and Imperial College London.
- Selected clients: Microsoft, Shell, Coca-Cola, Unilever, HSBC, adidas, Heineken, Bank of England, Aston Martin, DP World, Dubai Holding, Frasers Property, L'Oréal, Swarovski, Singtel, Schroders, GSK, Vodafone, Dyson, BT, Morgan Stanley.
- Offices: London (UK), Miami (US), Singapore, Dubai (UAE), Riyadh (Saudi Arabia).
